assessments.reasoning: IBM's official systemi V6R1 publications archive provides the PDF. Its title, edition notice, and preface identify the publication number and compiler baseline. The captured complete source exactly matches the registered digest dbaa18400cff7bedf2f772d6ac30f5f56413d7b42fa82e593acc882b8ab65912. The identified controlling passage is Chapter 3, Subprocedure Definition and Figure 5, printed pages 21–22 / PDF pages 71–72. The IBM V6R1 reference states that subprocedures do not run using the RPG cycle and that the compiler generates no cycle code for them. The claim addresses generated cycle code and not general availability of subprocedure features in other releases. The same chapter distinguishes a cycle-main procedure, which does use the RPG cycle. A later IBM 7.5 reference also differs in prototype rules, so no prototype conclusion is transferred.
